reference_inputs.role: correct four-tile floor grid only; no Dock hardware or capability

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image1 is the Power blueprint edit target. Image2 is ONLY a reference for the correct FOUR-TILE FLOOR GRID; do not copy its cabinet or other equipment.
Change ONLY image1's two internal floor lines. Delete its horizontal left-corner-to-right-corner axis and vertical back-corner-to-front-corner axis. Replace them with the SAME TWO DIAGONAL MIDPOINT-TO-MIDPOINT lines visible in image2: each parallel to one pair of the outer diamond edges, crossing in a shallow X at the floor centre and dividing the floor into FOUR EQUAL DIAMOND TILES. Absolutely no corner-to-corner axes or triangular floor regions.
Preserve image1's exact outer floor silhouette, camera, whole framing, TWO simple panel rectangle outlines and ONE little control-box wire cube. Do not adopt image2's hardware or move/add/remove equipment. Retain strong solid fully opaque cyan contours and true transparent background/interiors. No texture, noise, glow, dither, fills, labels, text, symbols or shadows. One complete isolated fixed view. The only intended change is correcting the interior floor grid using image2.
